requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible

cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
The only wolfdog sanctuary in Canada, we are a non-profit rescue dedicated to education and awareness about wolfdogs and wild wolves.

Our mission is to provide rescued wolfdogs with a meaningful and fulfilled life, while offering experiential education to promote the well-being and understanding of wolfdogs within our domestic world. By cultivating authentic connections between our wolfdogs and people, our goal is to inspire an appreciation for wolves in the wild and a reconnection to our natural world.

We are located just east of the Rocky Mountains near Cochrane, Alberta, on 160 acres with a current pack of 60+ resident wolfdogs. Along with our amazing wolfdogs, we have a visitor centre offering souvenirs and educational resources about wolfdogs and wild wolves. All proceeds from admissions and merchandise go directly toward caring for our wolfdogs and supporting future rescues.

Please note: children must be 6 years old or older to visit due to the sensitive nature of wolfdogs.
